title: Aaron Rodgers couldn't play forever, and he might have an unceremonious end at age 42

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers couldn't play forever, and he might have an unceremonious end at age 42
sources.description: There were four MVPs, 10 Pro Bowls, a Super Bowl championship, dozens of highlights that defied belief over 22 seasons, and it all seems to end with a quick statement from the team after most of Pittsburgh had gone to sleep.
